meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: Claude 会先问清需求,优先调用专用技能或 ncl 命令来添加频道、改配置、装集成,改完告诉你如何验证。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加频道(如 Telegram、Slack)、修改触发规则、新增集成或做其他自定义时触发。

say.text: 把 Telegram 添加为输入渠道
say.note: 会先确认隔离级别和归属组。

say.text: 给某个 agent 组换模型
say.note: 会修改该组的容器配置。

say.text: 接入一个日历 MCP 集成

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude asks clarifying questions, then uses dedicated skills (like /add-telegram) or ncl commands to add channels, change triggers, add integrations, or adjust other config, and ends by telling you how to verify.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change trigger rules, add an integration, modify the router, or make any other NanoClaw customization.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel
say_en.note: Claude will ask about isolation level first.

say_en.text: Change the model for a specific agent group
